title: Automated email reminders (verify email + add expense nudge)
description: New RemindersModule with daily cron: verification reminder (max 3, every 3d, non-optional) and expense-add nudge (max 5, every 14d, opt-out via expenseRemindersEnabled). Adds lastLoginAt, lastVerificationReminderAt, verificationReminderCount, lastExpenseReminderAt, expenseReminderCount, expenseRemindersEnabled to User. New MailService methods, new /user/notification-settings endpoint + profile UI toggle.

title: Admin panel: show more info about users
description: Show emailVerified status, lastLoginAt, and last expense date in admin user list/detail (backend admin.service.ts + frontend admin.tsx).
